package.description: The dedicated blood pressure software of Microlife professional blood pressure monitoring product series.

en-US.description: The dedicated blood pressure software of Microlife professional blood pressure monitoring product series.
en-US.longDescription: WatchBP Analyzer is the dedicated blood pressure software of Microlife professional blood pressure monitoring product series. It can connect and transfer data from WatchBP Office 2G, WatchBP Office Vascular, WatchBP Office ABI, WatchBP Office AFIB, all WatchBP O3 variants, WatchBP Home (LOT after 2023-07-25), WatchBP Home A(LOT after 2023-07-25), and WatchBP Home A BT(LOT after 2023-07-25).
en-US.name: WatchBP Analyzer

zh-CN.description: 迈克大夫专业血压监测产品系列的专用血压软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: WatchBP Analyzer 是迈克大夫专业血压监测产品系列的专用血压管理软件。它可以连接并传输来自 WatchBP Office 2G、WatchBP Office Vascular、WatchBP Office ABI、WatchBP Office AFIB、所有 WatchBP O3 系列型号、WatchBP Home（生产批号在 2023-07-25 之后）、WatchBP Home A（生产批号在 2023-07-25 之后）以及 WatchBP Home A BT（生产批号在 2023-07-25 之后）的设备数据。
